description: This file is a shell script for testing Git push.default configurations. It sets up repositories, performs push operations with various configurations, checks outcomes, and verifies expected Git behavior related to push defaults in different workflows.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Verifies that the latest commit in one revision matches the commit in a remote repository.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Performs a git push with a specified push.default value and checks if the push is successful.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Performs a git push with a specified push.default value and expects it to fail.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Tests push behaviors in different workflows (centralized and triangular) with specified push.default settings.
